method: IQ acquired counter counts cf32 samples successfully copied from each radio TX into its broker ring. Compare samples at monotonic heartbeat t=60 and t=130; per-port counts, not message or producer-call counts. Independently unwrap gNB SFN.slot and divide endpoint slot progress by wall time inside each 120-second measurement. Heartbeat comparison uses an interior window rather than exactly the same 120-second endpoints.
heartbeat_timing_bound: Integer seconds imply conservative 69–71 s elapsed for the selected nominal 70 s window; both bounds remain below nominal rate.
